headline: Market closed Fri 09-11 20:00 ET → Sun 09-13 20:00 ET (48 h): risk-adding blocked on every tick; first allowed again Sun 09-13 21:00 ET.
Risk-adding blocked 49.42 h of 65.75 h; largest pool-vs-fair gap 52.6 bp, pool above fair (Sun 09-13 20:02 ET); median |gap| 5.5 bp closed vs 3.8 bp open.
Lane A ($50): 1 initial placement before the window, 0 re-centers and 0 exits in it; its position was in range 64% of the closed window (held, not exited: reduce-only in M2).

A control lane in range all through the 48 h closed window ($1k, ±100 ticks) paid $4.24 to informed flow and earned $3.32 in fees (net −$0.92). DeltaDesk added no risk while closed (every risk-adding step was gated; a position placed before the close is held, not exited, in M2).
